title: artifact,farm,volume: move flag compat check after subcommand entrypoint is called
body:
Follow-up from #30237 

We should move flag compatibility check before the subcommand entrypoint is invoked. I don't think this greatly affects performance but purely from a hygiene point of view, this seems incorrect. Some instances:

 `system df` https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/598920feef00dabf01a400865bc2d3458e9cee1d/cmd/podman/system/df.go#L53-L60

 `image mount` https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/598920feef00dabf01a400865bc2d3458e9cee1d/cmd/podman/images/mount.go#L66-L86

 `container mount` https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/598920feef00dabf01a400865bc2d3458e9cee1d/cmd/podman/containers/mount.go#L88-L112

 `generate systemd` https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/598920feef00dabf01a400865bc2d3458e9cee1d/cmd/podman/generate/systemd.go#L173-L215

vs how it's see how it's supposed to be:

`artifact` https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/db514bbd2163e27cddeb34e98fabadcbe44ac2de/cmd/podman/artifact/list.go#L87-L94

 `farm` https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/db514bbd2163e27cddeb34e98fabadcbe44ac2de/cmd/podman/farm/list.go#L59-L71

`volume` https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/db514bbd2163e27cddeb34e98fabadcbe44ac2de/cmd/podman/volumes/list.go#L66-L80

cc/ @simonbrauner

comments.body: You're right, I think I might have jumped the gun here. Let me see if there any instances of this happening in the codebase first and not simply open an exploration issue. Sorry :)
Updated with code snippets that seem to indicate the incorrect order.
